beta_eintrag.label: Verknüpfter Beta-Eintrag
beta_eintrag.description:
A reference to a LivingApp record from the target lookup app 'Einheit Beta' with the id `6abd3e62e41a830f98d5e8b8` (or `null`/`None`).

The field value will be a valid record URL in the form `https://my.living-apps.de/rest/apps/6abd3e62e41a830f98d5e8b8/records/<record-id>` (or `null`/`None`).

When writing, either pass a record URL through exactly as this API returned it, or send the portable relative form `/apps/6abd3e62e41a830f98d5e8b8/records/<record-id>`. Other equivalent record-URL forms are accepted as well.

Displayed as single-select field in HTML pages.
